codex_note:
## Codex runtime mapping

Use the pinned [Comment Sicko role](references/comment-sicko-agent.md) for a bounded native reviewer. Assign the reviewer explicit file ownership and pass the exact scope; the coordinator checks its report and diff, performs accepted implementation fixes, and runs verification. Follow `model-capability-router`; the reviewer is not authority. Optional constraint encodings use the approval checkpoint in Step 5. Do not install Cursor hooks or a global agent.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
